therapeutic_hypothesis.intended_biology: prevention of post-transplant relapse through epigenetic modulation
therapeutic_hypothesis.target_population: patients with MDS and AML at high risk for post-transplant relapse following T cell depleted allogeneic stem cell transplantation

results.dose_information: 32mg/m2 subcutaneous for 5 days every 28 days, 8-10 cycles, dose de-escalation permitted for toxicities

context.duration: treatment started days 60-120 post-transplant, continued up to 1 year post-transplant
